findings_and_limits.observation: The policy claims to track the eight largest product files, but the checker validates only the eight paths already in the manifest. It neither discovers repository-wide largest files nor requires exactly eight records. A larger unlisted file could grow without this guard noticing.

The report lacks HEAD/source/manifest digests and source references for its hardcoded historical baselines. The test proves arithmetic on a synthetic file; it does not authenticate those baseline measurements.

The generator creates the destination and writeFileSync replaces architecture-concentration.json; the configured ARCHITECTURE_EVIDENCE_DIR is not constrained to an approved root. The default output already exists, so the CLI was deliberately not run.

Both checker and generator resolve hotspot.path under rootDir without rejecting absolute/traversal paths or verifying realpath containment. The current manifest contains repository-relative paths, but malformed future entries could count files outside the checkout.

The Node generator test leaves its mkdtemp fixture behind. The Vitest test also creates two mkdtemp fixtures without cleanup. The current Node test was contained and cleaned by the wrapper; the Vitest test was not rerun in this round.

Make both test suites remove their temporary fixtures and make evidence output exclusive or explicitly scoped before rerunning the generator CLI.
